scope: W07 target-machine acceptance (startup failure reporting and per-data-root WebView2 profile) on Windows 10 22H2 / RTX 3080 Ti / i7-13700K, using the NSIS package rebuilt from 376a3c3. The Windows 11 development-machine record stays in startup-diagnosis.json. This record also documents the target-machine retest of the 2026-11-03 second-instance exit code 101.

machine.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti 12288 MiB (sm86, driver 596.49)

package.note: The installed executable is the Tauri bundle-type-patched copy of target/release/image-studio-desktop.exe, so its SHA-256 differs from the intermediate release binary.

cases.name: webview2-runtime-unavailable
cases.setup: WEBVIEW2_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE_FOLDER points at an empty directory; isolated --data-dir
cases.expected: logs/startup-failure.log, a dismissible native error dialog, exit code 3

loader_dialog.title: Error
loader_dialog.text:
Could not find the WebView2 Runtime.

Make sure it is installed or download it from https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2

You may have it installed on another user account, but it is not available for this one.
loader_dialog.text_capture: UI Automation Pane text read after a 6 s settle in a separate probe; the verification run itself detected the dialog shell, dismissed it and continued.

application_dialog.title: Image Studio 启动失败
application_dialog.text:
Image Studio 启动失败
时间（UTC）：2026-11-03T12:01:09Z
原因：Failed to setup app: runtime error: Could not find the webview runtime, make sure it is installed
日志：\\?\<data-root>\logs\startup-failure.log
建议：确认 Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime 已安装且可启动；确认数据根可写；仍失败时保留本文件供排查。

cases.observations: On the target machine the WebView2 runtime raises its own TaskDialog ('Error', with a download link) before the setup panic. After that dialog is dismissed, the application writes logs/startup-failure.log, shows its own 'Image Studio 启动失败' dialog and exits with the documented code 3. The Windows 11 development-machine record observed the application dialog directly; the target machine has this one extra runtime-provided dialog first.

cases.observations: This variant reaches the application's own startup path directly (no WebView2 loader dialog), so it proves the panic hook, the log writer, the native dialog and exit code 3 independently of the WebView2 runtime dialogue.

cases.name: two-roots-separate-webview-profiles
cases.setup: two simultaneous instances with different --data-dir roots
cases.expected: both instances run; each root owns its WebView2 profile; the legacy shared profile is not used

second_instance_101.question: Does a second simultaneous instance with a different --data-dir exit with code 101 as recorded on 2026-11-03?

pre_fix_control.description: The previously installed package, built before the per-data-root WebView2 profile existed.

second_instance_101.limitation: Both automated runs start the first instance with an isolated --data-dir root. The original 2026-11-03 record was made during a manual package rebuild with the default product root as the first instance; the handoff forbids automating the user's real data root, so that exact setup was not replayed.
second_instance_101.conclusion: not_reproduced_on_target_machine; the silent exit-101 class is now reported by the startup diagnostics instead of disappearing without a log or dialog. Independent-root coexistence (W03) is verified on the target machine with the current package.
